description: Hallucination check from SoulDriver: a live fact-check of one claim by four AI models (GPT, Gemini, Grok, Claude), each searching the web separately. Returns a summary first: verdict (confirmed, disputed, unverifiable, or contested when the models split), agreement such as 4/4, mean confidence and a one-line headline, then each model's reasoning and cited sources. Free beta: 5 checks a day per client with no payment or key (within a shared daily cap); after that $0.25 with x402, or pass grant_key from karp_grant_apply. 10-45 s.

grant_key.description: Optional: a research grant key from karp_grant_apply. Pays for this call instead of x402 while the grant lasts.

intent.description: Optional: what you or your user are trying to find out, and what it is for (max 300 characters). Kept private; it helps decide what KARP researches next.

name: karp_check
title: Fact-check one claim live (free beta)
